2607.27973.title: TAPO: Transition-Aware Policy Optimization for LLM Agents
2607.27973.paper_summary: Recently, Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as a crucial paradigm for the post-training of Large Language Model (LLM) agents. However, existing methods predominantly rely on sparse task rewards for policy optimization, failing to fully exploit another class of inherently dense supervisory signals naturally present during online interaction: environmental feedback following action execution. Recent theoretical studies suggest that generalization in multi-step, goal-oriented tasks hinges on predictive knowledge of environmental consequences. Inspired by this, we propose TAPO: Transition-Aware Policy Optimization for LLM Agents, a unified training framework that alternates between policy optimization and transition supervision. Beyond standard RL updates, TAPO repurposes rollout data to apply action-conditioned next-observation prediction supervision on a shared backbone model. This approach enhances the model's sensitivity to environmental transition dynamics and action consequences while concurrently optimizing the policy. It serves as a computationally lightweight, plug-and-play enhancement module for existing agent RL algorithms, requiring no additional expert data, extra sampling costs, or inference-time overhead. We conduct systematic experiments on WebShop and ALFWorld, integrating foundation models of various scales with different policy optimization algorithms. Empirical results demonstrate that TAPO consistently improves task performance over pure policy optimization baselines.
2607.27973.paper_summary_zh: 最近，強化學習（RL）已成為大型語言模型（LLM）代理後訓練的一個關鍵範式。<lb/>然而，現有的方法主要依賴稀疏的任務獎勵來進行政策優化，未能充分利用在在線互動中自然存在的另一類固有的密集監督信號：行動執行後的環境反饋。<lb/>最近的理論研究表明，多步驟、以目標為導向的任務中的泛化依賴於對環境後果的預測知識。<lb/>受到此啟發，我們提出了 TAPO：針對 LLM 代理的過渡感知政策優化，一個統一的訓練框架，交替進行政策優化和過渡監督。<lb/>除了標準的 RL 更新外，TAPO 還重新利用回放數據，對共享的骨幹模型應用基於行動的下一觀察預測監督。<lb/>這種方法增強了模型對環境過渡動態和行動後果的敏感性，同時優化政策。<lb/>它作為一個計算輕量級的即插即用增強模組，適用於現有的代理 RL 算法，無需額外的專家數據、額外的採樣成本或推理時間的開銷。<lb/>我們在 WebShop 和 ALFWorld 上進行了系統實驗，將不同規模的基礎模型與不同的政策優化算法進行整合。<lb/>實證結果顯示，TAPO 始終在純政策優化基準上提高了任務性能。
